label: Frame Stripper
description: Drop one or more videos, get every frame as a separate numbered PNG. Multi-input renders prefix each frame with the source basename so files don't collide. One ffmpeg invocation per frame — use maxFrames to cap long inputs.

sourceIds.label: Source(s)
sourceIds.description: Source video(s) to strip into PNG sequences — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. Every frame becomes its own PNG.

clipStartMs.label: Clip start
clipStartMs.description: Source-relative ms where the extracted segment starts. Paired with clipEndMs to scrub out a section. Unset → start at 0.

clipEndMs.label: Clip end
clipEndMs.description: Source-relative ms where the extracted segment ends. Must be > clipStartMs when both are set. Unset → run to the end of the clip.

maxFrames.label: Max Frames (per input)
maxFrames.description: Cap on the number of frames extracted per input. Each frame is a separate ffmpeg invocation — long inputs are slow. Defaults to no cap.
